title: Adding In-Memory MCP Servers
excerpt: Adding In Memory MCP Servers This guide explains how to add in memory MCP servers that run within the browser, using the InMemoryTransport from the MCP SDK. Overview In memory servers are useful for: Testing MCP functionality without external servers Providing demo capabilities Development and debugging Offline functionality These servers run in the same JavaScript process as the client and communicate via the InMemoryTransport, eliminating network overhead and CORS issues.
